title: Microsoft outage shows the risks of relying on a single technology provider for essential services
summary: Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot, were interrupted. As the outage entered its second day Friday, Microsoft said it saw "encouraging recovery progress." But the company also warned that "intermittent access issues or delayed email delivery" may persist for some users.
llm_summary: Microsoft 365 suffered a multi‑day outage that knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the new Copilot AI assistant, with Microsoft reporting “encouraging recovery progress” but warning that some users may still face intermittent access or delayed email. The incident highlights the vulnerability of businesses that depend on a single vendor for critical communication and collaboration tools.
